sql.query: SELECT cv.id,cv.contractVersionNumber,cv.contractNameSnapshot,cv.pdfFileName,cv.pdfSha256,cv.issuedDate,COALESCE(u.displayName,'Unknown') issuedBy FROM tbl_contract_versions cv INNER JOIN tbl_generated_contracts gc ON gc.id=cv.contractId AND gc.tenantId=cv.tenantId LEFT JOIN tbl_users u ON u.id=cv.issuedByUserId WHERE cv.contractId=:contractId AND cv.tenantId=:tenantId AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tbl_user_tenant_roles utr WHERE utr.userId=:userId AND utr.tenantId=cv.tenantId AND utr.isActive=1) ORDER BY cv.contractVersionNumber DESC
